title: Raj Bhoga Seva
detail: Sponsor the midday feast offered to Sri Sri Radha Madhava on a date of your choice.

title: Sunday Feast Seva
detail: Sponsor the prasadam feast served to everyone at the Sunday Love Feast.

title: Shringar Seva
detail: Flowers and garlands for the morning dressing of the Deities.

title: Go Seva
detail: Fodder and care for the cows that give milk for the Lord's offerings.

title: Tulasi Seva
detail: Care of the Tulasi garden and the daily Tulasi puja.

title: Sadhu Bhojan
detail: Feed the monks and full-time devotees who serve the temple.

title: Nitya Seva
detail: A monthly pledge that keeps the daily worship running all year.

title: Birthday & Anniversary Puja
detail: An archana in your name with prasadam sent home.

title: General Donation
detail: Let the temple use your gift where it is most needed.
